PowerShell(Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.LocalPort -ge 3000 -and $_.LocalPort -le 9999 } | Select-Object LocalAddress, LocalPort, OwningProcess | Sort-Object LocalPort | Format-Table -AutoSize)
